title: FendixJSONReport
description: Schema for Fendix scan output produced by `fendix scan --format json`. Current reports carry metadata.schema_version 2. Additive fields do not require a version bump; incompatible shape or semantic changes do. Archived pre-versioned and schema-version 1 reports remain readable. See docs/schema.md.

gaps.description: Analyzer names whose scanner_status is a gap, then, for an import, one `import/<tool>` entry for every producer whose run was recorded as failed or partial (executionSuccessful false, an exit signal, a non-zero exit code, an error-level notification). A scan is configured_complete only with no gap.

ActiveProbeCoverage.description: Present when active probing was enabled. Accounts for every active probe sent. A scan-wide configured_complete is never proof that every probe was evaluated: read this beside it. attempted = evaluated + inconclusive + unknown_origin + scanner_failed. A probe the target answered with 401, 403, 404 or 410 is gated: not evaluated, counted inside inconclusive and itemised in gated. Required-probe coverage is complete only when every planned probe was evaluated (attempted = evaluated): there is no percentage threshold, and one unevaluated probe, whoever's it is, makes the pass incomplete. The not_evaluated_* keys, groups_total, inline_truncated, listing_ceiling_reached and listing_overflow (all additive; absent from reports of engines before the bounded-evidence contract) account for every unevaluated probe in storage whose size does not follow the probe count.

evaluated.description: A response came back and the check judged it.

inconclusive.description: Target-side non-evaluation: a confirmed non-answer, a redirect into an address the SSRF guard refuses, or a gated answer (401, 403, 404, 410; see gated). Not an evaluation, never evidence that anything is absent, safe or fixed. Target-owned, not a scanner failure, but still not evaluated: the pass is incomplete.

unknown_origin.description: No evidence settles whose fault the failure is. Fail-closed: not evaluated, and a coverage gap for active-probes.

scanner_failed.description: The engine failed or never sent the probe. Not evaluated, and a coverage gap for active-probes.

reasons.description: {origin: {reason: count}}. Origins: target, unknown, scanner. Reasons are a closed vocabulary per origin.

not_evaluated_checks.description: Distinct (check, endpoint, origin, reason) with a probe that was not evaluated, scanner then unknown then target. A (check, endpoint) pair absent from the list was evaluated only when truncated is false.

truncated.description: not_evaluated_checks was cut at 200 entries, or the group listing reached its ceiling (see listing_ceiling_reached).

not_evaluated_counts.description: The exact aggregate of the probes that were not evaluated: one row per (origin, reason, HTTP status) with a non-zero count, in a fixed order. The vocabularies are closed, so a few dozen rows at most whatever the probe count. The counts add up to attempted - evaluated; a report whose counts do not add up is unreadable and its pass is not complete.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer that was not evaluable (gated 401/403/404/410, rate limited 429, service unavailable 502/503/504); absent or null when the reason carries no HTTP status (a timeout, a reset, DNS, transport).

not_evaluated_groups.description: At most 200 (endpoint, origin, reason) groups of unevaluated probes with the check families they cover, in a fixed order. The groups shown are exact. Every group left out is counted: groups_total minus the groups shown.

endpoint.description: METHOD /path, exactly as a finding names its endpoint.

groups_total.description: The groups the engine listed, at most the listing ceiling (100,000). Greater than the groups shown exactly when inline_truncated.

inline_truncated.description: groups_total exceeds the groups shown in not_evaluated_groups. Counted, not lost: the aggregate in not_evaluated_counts is exact.

listing_ceiling_reached.description: There were more groups than the engine's hard listing ceiling (100,000). The unevaluated probes whose group detail was therefore not recorded are counted in listing_overflow, and the aggregate counts stay exact. A pass that reached the ceiling is never complete.

listing_overflow.description: The exact number of unevaluated probes whose group detail was not recorded because the listing ceiling was reached; 0 otherwise.

gated.description: The probes the target answered with 401, 403, 404 or 410. A gated probe is NOT evaluated and is evidence of nothing: the request was refused or the path is not served to this client, not proof that the parameter is safe. It is target-side (never a scanner gap, never refunded) and is counted inside inconclusive and reasons.target.gated. Always present from the engine that adds it; absent from older reports.

by_status.description: Non-zero counts by HTTP status; keys are 401, 403, 404, 410 only.

cut_short.description: Present only when a limit set for the scan ended the probe pass: probes it never started are in no count above. The engine cannot say who set the limit, only which flag and what value.

configured.description: The limit's value as given to the engine, for example 45s or 500.

check.description: The rule-id family of the findings the probe could produce: injection, xss, ssrf, openredirect, hostheader, graphql, methodtamper.

endpoint.description: METHOD /path, exactly as a finding names its endpoint.

evidence.description: A fixed phrase stating what was observed.

StatusCounts.description: v0.24 decision summary. Additive; not in the root `required` set.

execution_successful.description: The producer's own account of its run, folded across the tool's runs and files: false when any invocation failed (executionSuccessful false, an exit signal, or a non-zero exit code with no success recorded); true only when every invocation said it succeeded. Absent when the document does not say: absent means not recorded, never fine. A false makes `import/<tool>` a coverage gap.

error_notifications.description: Error-level notifications the producer raised (toolExecutionNotifications and toolConfigurationNotifications), summed across the tool's runs. Absent when no invocation was recorded. Above zero makes `import/<tool>` a coverage gap: the run may be partial.

analyzed_paths.description: The files the run lists as analysed (artifacts that were code the run read), repo-relative, sorted, at most 4096.

ConfidenceReason.description: One scoring rule's contribution to a confidence score. `code` is the stable machine-readable identity a consumer matches on; `text` is human wording and is free to be reworded. The `delta` values of a finding's confidence_breakdown sum to its confidence_score.

Occurrence.description: One security occurrence: where it is, and its own fendix/v2 fingerprint, computed from that occurrence alone before any grouping.

occurrences.description: Every distinct security occurrence this finding presents, one per (endpoint, occurrence fingerprint). Identity, .fendix-ignore matching, baseline matching and lifecycle tracking act on occurrences; the finding is a presentation group. The finding's own fingerprint is its primary occurrence's and always appears here. Absent on reports from engines that predate the field.

allOf.description: Severity-confidence consistency: LOW confidence caps severity at MEDIUM.
